```{r libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse) # also attaches ggplot2, dplyr, readr, etc.
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
library(sf)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(kableExtra)
library(here)
library(arrow) # fast CSV reading and lazy queries on large Parquet data

source(here("R", "od_io.R"))
```

```{r build-od-parquet}
# The raw OD CSVs are far larger than memory (bus: ~18 GB in total), so we do
# not load them all at once. Instead, every monthly CSV in data/raw/OD/ is
# converted once into a Parquet dataset in data/processed/od_parquet/
# (about 8x smaller on disk). Months already converted are skipped, so this
# chunk is slow only the first time and after new months are downloaded.
build_od_parquet()

od <- open_od() # lazy: nothing is read into memory yet
od
```

```{r load-od-2021}
# Filter first, then collect() only the rows you need. MODE is "train" or
# "bus"; YYYYMM is an integer such as 202001. Bus stop codes stay as text, so
# leading zeros (e.g. "01012") are kept for joining with spatial data.
dfT21 <- c(202103, 202106, 202109, 202112)

od_train_2021 <- od |>
  filter(MODE == "train", YYYYMM %in% dfT21) |>
  collect()
```

```{r load-od-2022}
# Filter first, then collect() only the rows you need. MODE is "train" or
# "bus"; YYYYMM is an integer such as 202001. Bus stop codes stay as text, so
# leading zeros (e.g. "01012") are kept for joining with spatial data.
dfT22 <- c(202203, 202206, 202209, 202212)

od_train_2022 <- od |>
  filter(MODE == "train", YYYYMM %in% dfT22) |>
  collect()
```

```{r load-od-2023}
# Filter first, then collect() only the rows you need. MODE is "train" or
# "bus"; YYYYMM is an integer such as 202001. Bus stop codes stay as text, so
# leading zeros (e.g. "01012") are kept for joining with spatial data.
dfT23 <- c(202303, 202306, 202309, 202312)

od_train_2023 <- od |>
  filter(MODE == "train", YYYYMM %in% dfT23) |>

```

```{r}
head(od_train_2021)
head(od_train_2022)
head(od_train_2023)
```


```{r}
months_sel <- c(dfT21, dfT22, dfT23)

od_train_21_23 <- od |>
  filter(MODE == "train", YYYYMM %in% months_sel) |>
  collect() |>
  mutate(
    YEAR  = YYYYMM %/% 100L,
    MONTH = YYYYMM %% 100L,
    period = case_when(
      DAY_TYPE == "WEEKDAY" & TIME_PER_HOUR %in% c(6, 7, 8, 9) ~ "AM peak",
      DAY_TYPE == "WEEKDAY" & TIME_PER_HOUR %in% c(17, 18, 19, 20) ~ "PM peak",
      DAY_TYPE == "WEEKDAY"                                     ~ "Weekday off-peak",
      TRUE                                                      ~ "Weekend/holiday"
    )
  )

count(od_train_21_23, YEAR, MONTH)
```
